**EcoCompute v3.0.7 — transparent grounding and framework-ready recommendations**

- **Framework integration mappings** — every NF4 / INT8 / FP8 recommendation now ships with one-line snippets for transformers · vLLM · TGI · Ollama · llama.cpp · TensorRT-LLM, with explicit caveats where framework flags don't expose fine-grained controls.
- **Transparent default handling** — when GPU / model / precision / batch-size inputs are incomplete, the skill degrades gracefully via explicit rules (closest-platform fallback, built-in name → parameter lookup, conservative FP16 / BS=1 assumptions) and always states the assumption and confidence downgrade.
- **Dataset version binding** — every response ends with a traceable footer `Evidence: zenodo.org/records/18900289 (2025-Q1) · skill v3.0.7`, so the data lineage is never ambiguous.
- **Requirements clarified** — no installation, no GPU, no dependencies on the user side; the skill operates fully read-only via prompt and response.
- **Changelog history** — prior releases (v3.0.5 cleanup, v3.0.6 architecture-aware crossover + anti-pattern split) are now documented inline so users can see the evolution.
